issue.title: P0 Author IDE autosave: stale revision after rapid undo (P1 S09, WF1F-S09-001)
issue.body:
## Summary / impact

**Confirmed in real Playwright, not just unit tests.** P1 S09 on `codex/ai-copilot-pipeline-test` (tested source `34fff042c3272e9661f7bf7163f290b4b5483568`) showed **editor body B** while server draft and latest immutable revision incorrectly held **temporary body A** after a fast Undo. This can make narrative analysis extract a source different from the author's visible text; P1 S10/S11 are blocked pending repair.

**Saved evidence**
- [Wave 1F report](https://github.com/Ephurin/Novel_sharing_platform/blob/codex/ai-copilot-pipeline-test/Pipeline_test/reviews/2026-10-21-p1-wave-1f/EXECUTOR_WAVE_1F_REPORT.md)
- [Deterministic defect metadata](https://github.com/Ephurin/Novel_sharing_platform/blob/codex/ai-copilot-pipeline-test/Pipeline_test/reviews/2026-10-21-p1-wave-1f/S09_DEFECT_PROOF.json)
- [Minimal old-code patch concept](https://github.com/Ephurin/Novel_sharing_platform/blob/codex/ai-copilot-pipeline-test/Pipeline_test/reviews/2026-10-21-p1-wave-1f/S09_PATCH_PROPOSAL.md)
- [S09 persisted readback](https://github.com/Ephurin/Novel_sharing_platform/blob/codex/ai-copilot-pipeline-test/Pipeline_test/runs/2026-10-21-p1-wave1f-workflow-01/browser-incremental-resume-01/S09-debounce-readback.json)

**Reproduction on test branch:** Saved B → edit A → Undo to B after ~264 ms (less than 1200-ms debounce). Editor B; server persisted A (bad revision `737c2025-d940-44b7-b3d5-7ea31b112123`). `web/src/features/author-ide/AuthorWritingIde.tsx:452–477` returns on `!hasChanged` *before* clearing the earlier timer, allowing stale A to dispatch.

## IMPORTANT: FE implementation is different on PR #55

The open FE PR **#55** (`feat/author-workflow-hardening` → `feat/author-workspace`) no longer uses this exact inline autosave logic. Its `AuthorWritingIde.tsx` calls `useDraftPersistence.ts::queue()` with `slot.pending`, `slot.running`, `slot.saved` and `expectedVersion`. This is an architectural improvement **but does NOT establish S09 PASS without equivalent browser/in-flight test**. In the hook `queue()`, the `same(value,slot.saved) && !slot.running` branch clears pending without clearing timer, which may be harmless given `drain()` checks `pending`; test state transitions and callback races, not just pattern-match source. When `slot.running`, the hook queues the new value, so an intermediate older revision may still be saved; verify eventual consistency and no stale downstream analysis is falsely approved.

**Request to FE owner:** fix/test in your FE source branch against the actual `useDraftPersistence` implementation; avoid cherry-picking the old inline fix into the new hook blindly. Do **not** modify the P1 evidence branch or merge it into FE as a quick workaround.

## Required acceptance tests (including real browser)

- [ ] **B → A → B within 1.2s:** final server draft/revision remains B; zero stale-A revisions/outbox when request has not dispatched; UI shows saved.
- [ ] **A → C within 1.2s:** only latest C is sent after debounce; content title/VIP/price consistent.
- [ ] **A in-flight → B restore:** explicit durable consistency contract; final canonical B after all requests settle; preserve source/revision ordering; no silent stale overwrite or misleading saved indicator.
- [ ] **Rapid chapter switch / account switch / route navigation:** never persist chapter X content to chapter Y; active drafts are recovered or user is clearly blocked from leaving.
- [ ] **Two concurrent tabs / 409 expectedVersion:** no silent lost updates; local draft recovery preserved and conflict visible.
- [ ] **Provider/outbox effects:** duplicate/stale immutable revision or outbox must not cause stale canon to be treated as latest; no cross-chapter/owner writes.
- [ ] Include focused frontend hook tests plus real Playwright S09 retry on a **fresh isolated fake-provider stack**. Record SHA, screenshots/trace and read-only revision hashes, not just "unit tests passed."

**Cross-branch coordination:** Report actual FE patch commit and minimal diff, then let Codex safely bring the **reviewed fix only** into `codex/ai-copilot-pipeline-test` with a clear provenance commit. Do not merge the entire FE PR into the isolated P1 test branch without explicit compatibility review. Retest S09 and then S10/S11 separately. Protect all historical Wave 1F evidence.

**No new real Gemini/paid calls required.** The P1 test branch is OFFLINE ONLY; the user deferred exact paid-tier USD budget math, not source integrity or operational isolation.

comments.body:
## FE re-review handoff — source `7b15c07` (2026-10-22)

The new FE head on PR #55 is `7b15c078c1ffe2fca96c4e66c96577e3ff007c3c`. Its `useDraftPersistence.ts` now (a) cancels a pending debounce before checking whether content returned to the last saved value, (b) serializes in-flight/pending buffers and preserves `expectedVersion` conflict handling, (c) retires pending buffers on account switch, scopes backups by user/chapter, and (d) prevents stale callbacks from updating a new account's UI. `AuthorWritingIde.tsx` also keys chapter queries/buffer readiness to the account.

**Available evidence:** `docs/development/PR-54-55-REVIEW/README.md`, `draft-readback.json`, trace/screenshot artifacts, and opt-in `web/tests/draft-persistence.browser.test.mjs`. The recorded local Playwright mounted **real hook + fixture** with isolated backend shows B→A→B under debounce: 0 PATCH, unchanged snapshot/outbox; in-flight saves, account/chapter switching, cross-tab 409 and recovery were also exercised. The PR head CI workflow jobs are green. This is evidence for the **new hook**; it is NOT equivalent to a full production Author IDE run or a S09 PASS on P1 test branch.

**Keep this issue OPEN until independent P1 acceptance:**
1. Codex/FE integration must identify a minimal **compatible** patch for `codex/ai-copilot-pipeline-test`. The hook relies on API `expectedVersion`, `draftVersion`, 409 semantics and supporting migrations. Do **not** cherry-pick the hook in isolation, merge the whole FE branch into P1, or overwrite historical RED evidence.
2. Run fresh offline-only full-editor Playwright S09 with saved B → A → Undo B, then A in-flight → B, chapter/account switch, route/reload and concurrent-tab 409. Assert visible editor == backend draft and correct immutable revision/outbox + active Story Brain source hashes. Label the source/head SHA and preserve trace/readback.
3. Once S09 passes, separately execute S10 and S11, recording new evidence. No real Gemini/provider calls needed.

The earlier Wave1G RED finding belongs to the **old editor implementation**, and must not be misreported as a failure of this updated PR hook. Conversely, the fixture PASS does not close this P1 incident.
